statementOfApproval: The English-language draft content for ch01-t05 (Average and Instantaneous Speed), as it exists in docs/content-design/chapter-01/batch1-drafts/ch01-t05-content.json at the checksum recorded in approvedDraftFiles, is approved by the project owner as the ch01-t05 English baseline version 1.0.0. This approval is a project-owner content-readiness decision made on the basis of Claude's completed drafting (PR G1), correction (PR G1's scientific correction pass), and review work (PR G1A, this record) — it is not an independently derived, third-party human scientific or editorial re-verification beyond that work, and it does not itself authorize Arabic translation, visual production, application integration, or any student-facing use.

criteriaChecked: Average speed is total distance divided by total elapsed time
Stops are included unless moving-time-only is explicitly requested
Distance is not confused with displacement
Instantaneous speed is distinguished from average speed
Arithmetic averaging is restricted to the equal-time special case
No calculus, limit, derivative, or shrinking-interval explanation remains
No Bolt example or unresolved event/time pairing appears in teaching content
All numerical examples and problem calculations are correct
scientificReviewFindings.result: All 8 records satisfy all 12 criteria. Numerical verification: general example (4000 m + 3000 m = 7000 m; 200 s + 100 s + 300 s = 600 s; 7000/600 ≈ 11.7 m/s; naive (20+10)/2 = 15 m/s correctly shown as wrong) and ch01-prob-105 (1200 m + 1800 m = 3000 m; 150 s + 60 s + 200 s = 410 s; 3000/410 ≈ 7.317 m/s, correctly rounded to 7.3 m/s at 2 significant figures; segment speeds 1200/150 = 8.0 m/s and 1800/200 = 9.0 m/s consistent with the intuition check) were independently recomputed and confirmed correct. Programmatic scan of the full file confirmed no occurrence of 'pace', 'min/km', 'derivative', 'shrink', or the standalone word 'lim' anywhere, and confirmed 'Bolt', 'Berlin 2009', 'Beijing 2008', '9.58', and '9.69' occur only inside governance/disclosure fields (generationNote, instructorOnlyCautions, sourceTraceability.evidence) and never in any teaching-content field.
scientificReviewFindings.conclusion: The draft passes scientific and editorial review without modification. No further correction was required or applied as part of this baseline approval.
